name: Asana
description: Asana's developer platform offers a RESTful API, webhooks and app components for work-management automation.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens (PATs), Enterprise-tier Service Account tokens and OAuth; OpenID Connect also described.
gate_detail: PATs are generated in the developer console and suffice for single-user apps; OAuth for multi-user apps. Service Accounts (needed for audit log, SCIM, exports) are Enterprise-only and super-admin created. Free-plan status not stated.
api_scope: RESTful JSON API for much of Asana's data, plus webhooks, app components, Audit Log API, SCIM and organizational exports.
mcp_notes: No Asana-published MCP server appears in the sources; only a third-party directory page mentions an API key.
blocker_detail: Admin-level endpoints (audit log, SCIM, exports) need an Enterprise Service Account; standard API use does not.

evidence.quote: PATs are generated in the developer console .
Service Accounts are an Enterprise tier feature and can only be created by Asana super admins
This is the best choice if multiple users need to sign in to your app.
The Asana API is a RESTful interface, providing programmatic access to much of the data in the system.
Automate tedious work in powerful, bespoke ways with our platform

issues: Whether a free Asana plan can generate PATs is not stated.
